vo.text: Follow just one photosite on the sensor.
vo.speak: Follow just one photosite on the sensor.

vo.text: Light enters it and becomes an electrical signal.
vo.speak: Light enters it and becomes an electrical signal.

vo.text: More light makes a larger signal.
vo.speak: More light makes a larger signal.

vo.text: But that signal is only a brightness measurement.
vo.speak: But that signal is only a brightness measurement.

vo.text: This site's filter passes mostly green light.
vo.speak: This site's filter passes mostly green light.

vo.text: So it records green brightness at this location.
vo.speak: So it records green brightness at this location.

vo.text: Neighboring sites record red or blue through their filters.
vo.speak: Neighboring sites record red or blue through their filters.

vo.text: The processor compares neighbors to estimate each site's missing color values.
vo.speak: The processor compares neighbors to estimate each site's missing color values.

vo.text: Now red, green, and blue values describe one colored pixel.
vo.speak: Now red, green, and blue values describe one colored pixel.

vo.text: Repeat that millions of times, then reduce noise and adjust brightness.
vo.speak: Repeat that millions of times, then reduce noise and adjust brightness.

vo.text: Many tiny measurements become the photograph you see.
